annotations.exact_quote: we propose a novel deep spatial-spectral subspace clustering network (DS3C-Net)
annotations.reason_zh: 摘要提出DS3C-Net深度聚类网络，并以可学习神经表示端到端学习亲和矩阵获得HSI聚类划分，符合深度聚类定义。

annotations.exact_quote: the collaborative constrained self-expressive layers are introduced between the encoder and decoder, to capture the self-expressive subspace structures
annotations.reason_zh: 通过自表达层捕获自表达子空间结构，并据此进行聚类，符合子空间聚类定义。

annotations.exact_quote: Hyperspectral image (HSI) clustering is a challenging task due to the complex characteristics in HSI data
annotations.reason_zh: 研究对象为高光谱图像数据，处理其空间-光谱结构与高维特性。

annotations.exact_quote: the affinity matrices of the feature representation are learned in an end-to-end manner
annotations.reason_zh: 显式端到端学习特征表示的亲和矩阵，即学习样本间亲和/图结构，符合图结构学习定义。
